supplements.title: Unregulated use of Artemisia in cancer patients in Libya: an emerging ethical and public health concern.
supplements.summary: Libyan cancer patients increasingly use unregulated Artemisia herbal remedies from social media, risking potential interference with standard cancer treatments.

supplements.title: Association between Gushen Antai recipe intervention and plasma cytokines during early pregnancy following IVF-ET: a cohort study.
supplements.summary: Herbal medicine Gushen Antai recipe may improve early pregnancy success after IVF by positively influencing plasma cytokine levels.

supplements.title: Coriandrum sativum improves prognosis in clear cell renal cell carcinoma by targeting NEK6 to modulate the immune microenvironment: a predictive study based on network pharmacology and multi-omics analysis.
supplements.summary: Coriander compounds may improve clear cell renal cell carcinoma prognosis by targeting NEK6 and enhancing immune cell interactions in the tumor microenvironment.

supplements.title: Mangiferin in human disease: Multifaceted mechanisms and applications (Review).
supplements.summary: Mangiferin, a natural compound, shows promise in suppressing cancer cell growth and inflammation by modulating key cellular signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Natural compound 5,7,8‑trimethoxyflavone mitigates radiation‑induced lung injury by suppressing EMT and PI3K/Akt pathway.
supplements.summary: A natural flavonoid compound can reduce lung damage from radiation therapy by blocking key cellular signaling pathways and preventing tissue transformation.

supplements.title: Reactivating necroptosis in colorectal cancer potentiates chemotherapy and antitumor immune responses.
supplements.summary: In colorectal cancer, the compound OSW-1 combined with 5-FU effectively kills cancer cells and boosts immune response by triggering cell death through multiple pathways.

supplements.title: Protective effect of Rosmarinus officinalis and its nanoparticles against chemobrain and neuroinflammation in rats: involvement of Wnt/β-catenin signaling and apoptotic machineries.
supplements.summary: Rosemary extract and its nanoparticles protected rat brain function and reduced neuroinflammation caused by oxaliplatin chemotherapy without interfering with cancer treatment.

supplements.title: 3'-Hydroxypterostilbene suppresses prostate cancer via apoptosis and autophagy in vitro and potent tumor growth inhibition in vivo.
supplements.summary: 3'-Hydroxypterostilbene effectively suppresses prostate cancer growth by inducing cell death through apoptosis and autophagy mechanisms.

supplements.title: Lactobacillus fermentum remodeled the lung microbiota by crosstalk with the gut and lungs and regulated the PI3K-AKT pathway to alleviate acute lung injury.
supplements.summary: Lactobacillus fermentum reduced lung inflammation by rebalancing gut and lung microbiota and suppressing a key cellular pathway in acute lung injury.

supplements.title: Ultrasound-assisted extraction of endemic Stachys antalyensis: LC-ESI-MS/MS phenolic profiling and in vitro antioxidant, enzyme-inhibitory, and cytotoxicity evaluation.
supplements.summary: Stachys antalyensis methanolic extract shows antioxidant and enzyme-inhibiting properties with low toxicity on lung cancer cells, demonstrating potential therapeutic value.

supplements.title: Comprehensive pharmacological insights into Glaucocalyxin A: Mechanisms and therapeutic potential.
supplements.summary: Glaucocalyxin A shows promising anti-tumor potential by targeting key cancer cell pathways, potentially regulating PI3K/Akt and p53 signaling.

supplements.title: Kaempferol suppresses prostate cancer metastasis and tumor angiogenesis via disrupting the LIMK1/Cofilin pathway.
supplements.summary: Kaempferol, a plant compound, suppresses prostate cancer growth and spread by disrupting a key cellular pathway that controls tumor blood vessel formation and cell division.

supplements.title: Celastrol induces cardiotoxicity by directly targeting AMOTL2 and inhibiting YAP1/PGC-1α/TFAM-dependent mitochondrial biogenesis.
supplements.summary: Celastrol causes heart damage by blocking a key protein (AMOTL2), which disrupts mitochondrial function and promotes cell death in heart tissue.

supplements.title: Structure-activity relationships reveal a 4-(2-pyridyl)chalcone as a potent cell death inducer.
supplements.summary: A specific chalcone (BHP) potently induced leukemia cell death by triggering mitochondrial apoptosis through caspase activation and oxidative stress.

supplements.title: Pachymic acid suppresses proliferation and invasion in colon cancer by inhibiting glycolysis via PPARγ/ENO1 pathway.
supplements.summary: Pachymic acid inhibits colon cancer cell growth and spread by disrupting sugar metabolism through a specific cellular pathway involving PPARγ.

off_label.title: Current status of anti-obesity medications and performance, an EHR based survey
off_label.summary: A comprehensive electronic health records study revealed that tirzepatide and semaglutide are the most effective anti-obesity medications, achieving significant weight loss in 42-48% of patients.

off_label.title: Aspirin and Atorvastatin Augmentation Treatment in Patients with Major Affective Disorders and Inflammatory Dysregulation: A 12-Week Randomized Placebo-Controlled Study.
off_label.summary: In patients with major affective disorders, combining aspirin and atorvastatin showed potential to enhance antidepressant treatment by addressing underlying inflammatory processes.

off_label.title: Aspirin and Atorvastatin Augmentation Treatment in Patients with Major Affective Disorders and Inflammatory Dysregulation: A 12-Week Randomized Placebo-Controlled Study.
off_label.summary:
Here's a concise summary:

Aspirin and atorvastatin may help reduce inflammation and improve symptoms in patients with major affective disorders.

off_label.title: Aspirin and Atorvastatin Augmentation Treatment in Patients with Major Affective Disorders and Inflammatory Dysregulation: A 12-Week Randomized Placebo-Controlled Study.
off_label.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

Aspirin and atorvastatin combined may improve depression symptoms in patients with inflammatory markers by reducing inflammation.

off_label.title: Aspirin and Atorvastatin Augmentation Treatment in Patients with Major Affective Disorders and Inflammatory Dysregulation: A 12-Week Randomized Placebo-Controlled Study.
off_label.summary: The study found that combining aspirin and atorvastatin may improve treatment outcomes for patients with major affective disorders by reducing inflammation.

off_label.title: Priapism Associated With the Rapid Titration of Prazosin: A Case Report.
off_label.summary: Rapid titration of prazosin, an alpha-1 antagonist medication, can trigger priapism by causing sudden dysregulation of penile blood flow.

off_label.title: Inpatient Use of Valproic Acid in Agitated Delirium by Palliative Medicine.
off_label.summary: Valproic Acid showed potential in managing agitation for hospitalized palliative patients, particularly those with cancer, without significant side effects or increased medication use.

off_label.title: Effect of treatment duration on the associations between three modern antidiabetic drugs and survival outcomes of lung cancer in China.
off_label.summary: In lung cancer patients with diabetes, longer use of certain antidiabetic drugs (GLP-1RA, DPP-4I, SGLT-2I) may improve survival outcomes.

off_label.title: The improvement effect and mechanism of traditional Chinese medicine on chemotherapy-induced diarrhea: a systematic review.
off_label.summary: Traditional Chinese medicine shows promise in alleviating chemotherapy-induced diarrhea by reducing inflammation, protecting intestinal barriers, and regulating gut flora.

off_label.title: Efficacy and safety of Traditional Chinese Medicine injections for no-reflow or slow flow in patients with acute coronary syndrome after percutaneous coronary intervention: a systematic review and network meta-analysis.
off_label.summary: Chinese medicine injections show potential in reducing ischemia-reperfusion injury and improving outcomes for patients after heart procedure interventions.

off_label.title: Priapism Associated With the Rapid Titration of Prazosin: A Case Report.
off_label.summary: A patient developed priapism (prolonged, painful erection) after quickly increasing his prazosin medication dosage without gradual titration.

off_label.title: Inpatient Use of Valproic Acid in Agitated Delirium by Palliative Medicine.
off_label.summary: In palliative care patients, including cancer patients, Valproic Acid showed potential for managing agitated delirium without additional sedative medications.

off_label.title: An acquired CCDC6::RET gene fusion as resistance mechanism for Osimertinib in exon 21 EGFR(L858R)-mutated non-small cell lung cancer and its successful management with Osimertinib and Selpercatinib: a case report and review of literature.
off_label.summary: A patient with lung cancer developed a RET gene fusion during Osimertinib treatment, which was successfully managed with a combination of Osimertinib and Selpercatinib, leading to 14 months of progression-free survival.

off_label.title: Hepatic-vascular crosstalk via GRK2: fenofibrate improves endothelial function by restoring lipid metabolism and NO signaling in obese mice.
off_label.summary: Fenofibrate improves blood vessel function in obese mice by enhancing nitric oxide signaling and lipid metabolism through a specific molecular pathway.

off_label.title: The efficacy and safety of lower-dose aspirin for primary and secondary prevention of cardiovascular disease in the elderly: an interim analysis of a multicenter, prospective, observational study.
off_label.summary: Low-dose aspirin shows potential for reducing cardiovascular disease risks in elderly patients while potentially minimizing bleeding complications, but more research is needed.

biomarkers.title: Collective directional memory controls the range of epithelial cell migration
biomarkers.summary: Epithelial cells migrate collectively more efficiently than individually, using coordinated velocity and adhesion to explore space over different timescales.

biomarkers.title: Spatial control of Keratin 8 phosphorylation by Aurora B facilitates cytokinesis in cancer cells of epithelial origin
biomarkers.summary: Aurora B kinase phosphorylates Keratin 8 at specific sites during cell division, facilitating keratin filament breakdown and successful cytokinesis in epithelial cancer cells.

biomarkers.title: HER2-driven mammary tumorigenesis enhances bioenergetics despite reductions in mitochondrial content
biomarkers.summary: In HER2-driven breast cancer, tumors show increased mitochondrial respiration despite reduced mitochondrial content, suggesting unique metabolic adaptations supporting cancer growth.

biomarkers.title: Adaptation of human cell populations to different levels of centriole amplification
biomarkers.summary: Cells with extra centrioles are negatively selected, but populations can adapt to maintain a consistent level of centriole amplification across different PLK4 overexpression levels.

biomarkers.title: PDL-1+ Neutrophils mediate susceptibility during endotoxemia in Metabolic Dysfunction Associated Steatotic Liver Disease
biomarkers.summary: In MAFLD mice, blocking PD-L1 on neutrophils or inhibiting IFN-γ reduced inflammatory damage during endotoxemia, potentially preventing severe systemic inflammation.

biomarkers.title: Disentangling cellular heterogeneity into interpretable biological factors through structured latent representations
biomarkers.summary: A computational method called DRVI effectively separates different cellular factors in single-cell genomics data, enabling clearer understanding of biological processes without relying on predefined assumptions.

biomarkers.title: Advancing Brain Tumor Diagnosis Using Deep Learning: A Systematic Review on Glioma Segmentation and Classification on Multiparametric MRI
biomarkers.summary: Deep learning models can accurately segment and classify glioma brain tumors using multiparametric MRI, achieving over 90% accuracy and potentially improving diagnostic precision.

biomarkers.title: Vasculopathy as a Mechanical Barrier to Cancer Spread: Clinical Evidence and a Rheology-Based Model in Lung Cancer
biomarkers.summary: In lung cancer patients with peripheral arterial disease, increased blood viscosity and inflammation appear to mechanically impede tumor cell spread, reducing metastasis by approximately 50%.

biomarkers.title: HER2-driven mammary tumorigenesis enhances bioenergetics despite reductions in mitochondrial content
biomarkers.summary: In HER2-driven breast cancer, mitochondrial protein levels decreased, yet mitochondrial respiration significantly increased, suggesting unique metabolic adaptation supporting tumor growth.

biomarkers.title: Adaptation of human cell populations to different levels of centriole amplification
biomarkers.summary: Cells regulate extra centriole numbers through negative selection, preventing uncontrolled centriole amplification that could lead to cancer development.

biomarkers.title: Collective directional memory controls the range of epithelial cell migration
biomarkers.summary: Epithelial cells in a tissue collectively migrate more efficiently than isolated cells, using coordinated velocity and adhesion to explore space over longer distances.

biomarkers.title: Spatial control of Keratin 8 phosphorylation by Aurora B facilitates cytokinesis in cancer cells of epithelial origin
biomarkers.summary: Aurora B kinase phosphorylates Keratin 8 at specific sites during cell division, facilitating keratin filament disassembly and cytokinesis in epithelial cancer cells.

biomarkers.title: PDL-1+ Neutrophils mediate susceptibility during endotoxemia in Metabolic Dysfunction Associated Steatotic Liver Disease
biomarkers.summary: In MAFLD, high-fat diet mice with PD-L1+ neutrophils show increased susceptibility to systemic inflammation, which can be mitigated by blocking PD-L1.

biomarkers.title: Disentangling cellular heterogeneity into interpretable biological factors through structured latent representations
biomarkers.summary: A new machine learning method can now separate complex single-cell genomic data into distinct, interpretable biological factors without losing analytical accuracy.

biomarkers.title: Advancing Brain Tumor Diagnosis Using Deep Learning: A Systematic Review on Glioma Segmentation and Classification on Multiparametric MRI
biomarkers.summary: Deep learning algorithms can now accurately segment and classify glioma brain tumors from MRI scans, achieving over 90% accuracy and potentially improving diagnostic precision and treatment planning.

trials.title: Current status of anti-obesity medications and performance, an EHR based survey
trials.summary: An electronic health record study found that FDA-approved obesity medications like tirzepatide and semaglutide can help some patients achieve 10-48% weight loss with metabolic improvements.

trials.title: Survival and morbidity in elderly patients treated with cytoreductive surgery and HIPEC for colorectal peritoneal metastases: a population-based study.
trials.summary: Elderly patients with colorectal peritoneal cancer can safely undergo cytoreductive surgery with heated chemotherapy, showing similar survival and complication rates as younger patients.

trials.title: Clinical efficacy of 2-week and 3-week albumin-bound paclitaxel therapy for advanced pancreatic cancer.
trials.summary: A comparison study found that two different schedules of albumin-bound paclitaxel showed similar effectiveness in treating advanced pancreatic cancer patients.

trials.title: Clinical outcomes of metastatic non-clear cell renal cell carcinoma: a real-world single-centre experience.
trials.summary: In patients with metastatic non-clear cell kidney cancer, combining immunotherapy with targeted therapy showed similar effectiveness compared to targeted therapy alone.

trials.title: Peptide-drug conjugates in tumor therapy: Current advances and future perspectives.
trials.summary: Peptide-drug conjugates show promise in cancer therapy by precisely targeting tumors, enhancing drug delivery, and reducing systemic toxicity.

trials.title: Long-term follow-up of zevor-cel in patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
trials.summary: A single CAR T-cell therapy infusion showed 100% response rate and promising long-term survival in heavily pretreated multiple myeloma patients.

trials.title: Late failure of aggressive B-cell lymphoma after CAR T-cell therapy: a LYSA study from the DESCAR-T registry.
trials.summary: In late-stage large B-cell lymphoma, bispecific antibodies showed better progression-free survival compared to other treatments after CAR T-cell therapy failure.

trials.title: Cabozantinib and thromboembolism in patients with cancer: a systematic review, meta-analysis, and retrospective study.
trials.summary: Cabozantinib significantly increases venous thromboembolism risk in cancer patients, especially during the first three months of treatment.

trials.title: Bio-reductive hetero-bimetallic Co(iii)-Pt(ii) complex for tumor-selective platinum release and cytotoxicity.
trials.summary: A novel Co(iii)-Pt(ii) complex selectively targets lung and breast cancer cells by releasing platinum under tumor-specific reductive conditions.

trials.title: [Evaluation of long-term prognosis of gastric cancer patients by tumor textbook outcome and analysis of related factors].
trials.summary: In gastric cancer patients, achieving textbook oncologic outcome is associated with significantly better long-term survival, particularly for younger patients with early-stage disease.

trials.title: Risk of bone fractures in patients with prostate cancer treated with maximal androgen blockade therapy: a systematic literature review and meta-analysis.
trials.summary: Prostate cancer patients receiving maximal androgen blockade therapy have a significantly increased risk of bone fractures compared to those on standard androgen deprivation therapy.

trials.title: The 'Comparison of diagnostic accuracy of Luminal Index and standard of care MRI for Accelerated deTEction of prostate cancer' (CLIMATE) trial protocol.
trials.summary:
Here's a clear, concise summary sentence:

This clinical trial protocol will evaluate a new, faster MRI technique (Luminal Index) for more accurately detecting clinically significant prostate cancer.

trials.title: Safety and effectiveness of selpercatinib in patients with RET fusion-positive non-small cell lung cancer in real-world clinical practice: a postmarketing study in Japan.
trials.summary: Selpercatinib showed promising safety and effectiveness for treating RET fusion-positive non-small cell lung cancer in real-world Japanese clinical settings.

trials.title: Impact of Early-Line Systemic Therapies on Liver Function in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Longitudinal Change of ALBI Score and Ammonia Level With and Without Anti-VEGF Agents.
trials.summary: Anti-VEGF therapy for hepatocellular carcinoma may compromise liver function by potentially inhibiting liver regeneration and impacting albumin-bilirubin scores.

trials.title: [Preliminary application of linear stapler-assisted en bloc resection of lateral pelvic sidewall for locally advanced rectal cancer and locally recurrent rectal cancer with significant pelvic occupation].
trials.summary: A surgical technique using linear staplers enables precise, less invasive removal of laterally invasive rectal cancer tumors while minimizing blood loss and complications.
